sloka: तां कराभ्यां परामृश्य रामः शक्तिं भयावहाम् ।बभञ्ज समरे क्रुद्धो बलवान् विचकर्ष च ।। ६.१०१.४४ ।।
transliteration: tāṁ karābhyāṁ parāmṛśya rāmaḥ śaktiṁ bhayāvahām ।babhañja samare kruddho balavān vicakarṣa ca ।। 6.101.44 ।।

translations.english: While Rama was pulling out the javelin, mighty and courageous Ravana struck him in his private parts and all over the body with arrows.
